questions.q: What does a bucket column let you do?
options: Create a new custom field on the object
Merge two report types into one
Schedule a report to run automatically
Group existing field values into named categories within one report
questions.explain: A bucket column categorizes an existing field's values into buckets you name, entirely inside the report — no new object field required.

questions.q: Where do you start building a bucket column?
options: The Columns dropdown, choosing Add Bucket Column
Setup > Object Manager
The Filters tab
The Report Type creation wizard
questions.explain: Add Bucket Column lives in the same Columns dropdown as Add Summary Formula and Add Row-Level Formula.

questions.q: A Billing Country field has values USA, France, and China. USA is assigned to bucket "NA," France to "Europe," and China is never assigned to anything. What happens to the China records?
options: They are excluded from the report entirely
They cause a validation error
They appear under Unbucketed Values
They are automatically placed in "NA"
questions.explain: Any source value not explicitly assigned to a bucket falls under Unbucketed Values — the records still appear in the report, just without a bucket assignment.

questions.q: When should you reach for a bucket column instead of building a custom formula field on the object?
options: When every report and every user across the org needs the same category permanently
When the categorization is only needed inside one specific report
When the field needs to be visible on the page layout
When the category must be enforced by validation rules
questions.explain: A bucket column only affects the one report it's built in. An org-wide, permanent category that every report and list view should see calls for an actual field on the object instead.

questions.q: What is the limit on bucket columns and buckets per report?
options: 1 bucket column, unlimited buckets
Unlimited bucket columns, 5 buckets each
Up to 5 bucket columns, 20 buckets each
Up to 20 bucket columns, 5 buckets each
questions.explain: A report can have up to five bucket columns, and each bucket column can contain up to twenty buckets.
